M5.L1.title: Classify shapes based on defining attributes using examples, variants, and non-examples.

M5.L2.title: Find and name two-dimensional shapes including trapezoid, rhombus, and a square as a special rectangle, based on defining attributes of sides and corners.

M5.L3.title: Find and name three-dimensional shapes including cone and rectangular prism, based on defining attributes of faces and points.

M5.L4.title: Create composite shapes from two-dimensional shapes.

M5.L5.title: Compose a new shape from composite shapes.

M5.L6.title: Create a composite shape from three-dimensional shapes and describe the composite shape using shape names and positions.

M5.L7.title: Name and count shapes as parts of a whole, recognizing relative sizes of the parts.

M5.L8.title: Partition shapes and identify halves and quarters of circles and rectangles.

M5.L9.title: Partition shapes and identify halves and quarters of circles and rectangles.

M5.L10.title: Construct a paper clock by partitioning a circle and tell time to the hour.

M5.L11.title: Recognize halves within a circular clock face and tell time to the half hour.

M5.L12.title: Recognize halves within a circular clock face and tell time to the half hour.

M5.L13.title: Recognize halves within a circular clock face and tell time to the half hour.
